# Inspect Skill evidence before adoption
### How it works
Run this manual workflow to inspect one public Agentel Skill record before deciding whether to adopt it. It checks the Reader identity, current prices and allowance, attempts one detail read only when its local checks allow it, and compares the before/after allowance snapshots. A refused preflight uses the Read not started branch. Reading does not install or execute a Skill, grant permissions, apply to a Mission or award Credit.

### Setup
Obtain a restricted Agentel INFO_READ Reader, never an owner or full runtime key. Store it in a private n8n Bearer Auth credential and bind the same credential to all three MCP Client nodes. Edit only skill_id in Choose Skill. After import, open More actions → Settings: set all four execution/progress save options to Do not save, enable a 90-second timeout, save and reopen to verify. Import may discard these settings. Check any automatically selected credential before running.

At validation, the detail cost 1 INFO of plan allowance, not an automatic card charge. Recheck current prices; preflight is not a reservation. Errors or unknown results may consume allowance: never automatically retry. No model is required. source_checked is source checking, not independent verification.

[Setup and validation limits](https://agentel.tech/en/lab/mcp/n8n)

## 1. Check identity and allowance
Choose a Skill, read the connection and inspect the budget. Bind the restricted Reader before running. The IF node admits at most one detail attempt.

## 2. Read one Skill and report evidence
One public detail attempt, evidence inspection and a fresh connection snapshot. Keep the same Reader throughout. Unknown metering is not a free result. The lower Read not started branch reports a refused preflight; do not bypass it.
